title: Contact variation of almost contact pseudo-metric structures
summary: For an almost contact pseudo-metric manifold we study a variation of the metric in the spirit of Meli-Ngakeu-Olea. Such variation is defined using a vector field on the manifold and the procedure shifts the signature of the metric by increasing the positive index by two. First we derive conditions on the vector field for the obtained manifold to remain almost contact pseudo-metric. Then we study the cases of almost pseudo co-Kähler manifolds.
